design_rules: separate primary objective, proxy reward, and diagnostics
write the intended behavior phases before choosing terms
include reachable progress feedback when final success is sparse
keep action, time, fuel, posture, and smoothness costs mild when they affect required behavior
include scale budgets for objective, progress, and regularizer terms
check component interactions before changing weights
store repeated failed edit patterns as hard constraints for the next revision
revision_questions: what behavior is the policy optimizing
what useful behavior is the policy avoiding
which component or interaction causes that behavior
which previous edit pattern should not be repeated
how should the next reward change behavior distribution
